Sequence is the positive optional Header.Work Sequence Number (R2712), decimal when rendered (D381), with direct decomposition default from D469. formulas.draft_archive: D650 Draft ID segment <canonical-ID>@<proposed-version>-draft; D289 archive segment <canonical-ID>@<unchanged-version> exactly once. Current normal ID unqualified. Explicitly retained historic legacy filenames are not automatically renamed.
formulas.external_project_goal: D292 Current requires canonical-ID[-or @version] + registered OPERATOR_NAMES + DEFINES_GOAL_FOR + exact Project Settings Name + Summary slug; its attribution token conflicts with latest single-person direction and source needs separately approved reconciliation. formulas.scope_unit_folder: D667: Project Authority .caprmedio_<project name>; nonroot path recursively follows declared parent with ordered <id>_<label>_<order>_<name> or unordered <id>_<label>_<name>; omit absent Label and unordered order segment. Stable IDs/declared names/parent/ordered/number come from Scope Unit Declarations, not path guessing.
formulas.atom_container_plan: D460/D469/D461: resolve exact declared containing Atom identity and its same-stem Directory Carrier; for contained Current Plan Active is directly in parent bundle, Backlog/Done/Canceled use local Status subdir. formulas.role_directories: D434 explicitly gives Operations 09_operations; D296 governs role directory materialization. current_atom_locator.py maps C 01_concern, A 02_analysis, P 03_plan, R 04_requirement, M 05_method, E 06_evaluation, D 07_delivery, O 09_operations. This is implementation evidence, not alone a source Declaration of every mapping.
formulas.world_bootstrap: Accepted Draft R2779 gives root Project Declaration Atom scope_unit CA-SU--1 (predefined world, no Declaration/Carrier/folder); Scope Unit Project root itself remains parentless. D264@30 Draft says physical placement readback matches Container; no world folder or generic ordinary default follows. Root Project Declaration Atom exact external placement must be resolved from admitted root-specific Delivery authority, not by synthesizing a world folder.

direct_properties: base Atom ID, Status, Version, Role, Form, explicit Label if any, Tier, complete Summary, Header.Container, Plan Work Sequence Number when present
Scope Unit ID, Name, Label, ordered state, order.number and parent; registered Project Name; admitted status-to-directory mapping
active Subject-derived target when a specific filename grammar requires it, and explicit Operator mapping only where still applicable Current D292 requires it
existing_carrier_evidence: A stored work_sequence_number is the logical source; if absent in a legacy carrier, a leading decimal is visible historical carrier representation but not by itself proof of a valid logical field. Reconcile under the chosen explicit migration/validation disposition before promoting that value; do not invent or renumber.

Likewise existing labels, scope/target tokens and filename segments are evidence to validate, not a blanket source of reconstructed Properties. Exact source bytes/version are available for preimage checks.
unresolved_when_missing: D283 describes optional segments; the exact per-role presence and permissible target/scope token encoding must be resolved from applicable current source, not guessed.
Authority for an external world-contained root Declaration destination and an Atom-container folder when no admitted parent bundle exists must be resolved; no world folder is implied.
No guessed transliteration/slug algorithm beyond the declared ASCII kebab/structured-token constraints; collisions and unrepresentable values require source-backed handling.

existing_helpers: proposed_carrier.source_context_from_project captures source-backed context; _current_containment_target/_current_containment_owner currently read legacy relations.IS_CONTAINED_BY rather than new Header.Container, and restrict Atom-parent eligibility to Plan. They are not evidence that the new mapping/world is already supported.
proposed_carrier._current_plan_parent_placement validates existing nested Plan placement; current_atom_locator maps role IDs to directories; neither is a complete generator for all new destinations.

atom_operations._filename_parts extracts existing filename fragments and _upgrade_filename reuses them; it is not an independent calculation from all logical Properties. lifecycle_intents._update_current_destination updates already-present destination fields for a chosen path, not a derivation engine.
limits: Read-only source and implementation inspection; no code, tests, native source or Git changes.
Current authority and prospective Draft agreements are labeled separately; no native Current adoption, runtime support or file movement implied.
